blocks.text: 137 מוּסַף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 137
מיוסד ע״ס א״ב מרובע.

אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי בְּצֶדֶק. תֵּת לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִשְׁפְּטֵי צֶדֶק. קוֹל לְהָרִים כַּשּׁוֹפָר: אֵין קוֹרֵא בְצֶדֶק. רוֹדֵף צֶדֶק צֶדֶק. אֶקְרָא שִׁמְעָה צֶדֶק. בְּקוֹל בָּלוּל כַּשּׁוֹפָר: בַּנְתִּי בְמַדָּעִי. לְמֵרָחוֹק שְׂאֵת דֵעִי. בִּטּוּי תְּרוּעָה בְּיָדְעִי. בְּקוֹל מַתַּן שׁוֹפָר: בּוֹ בְהָרִיעִי. אֲרַצֶּה לִי רוֹעִי. בְּאָמְצוֹ זְרוֹעִי. בְּקוֹל כֹּחַ שׁוֹפָר: גַּשְׁתִּי בְּיוֹם דִּין. לְהִתְוַכֵּחַ בַּדִּין. גּוֹלֶה עֹמֶק הַדִּין. בְּקוֹל קִפָּאוֹן שֹׁפָר: גְּזֵרַת דַּת וָדִין. אִם חִיַּבְתִּי בַּדִּין. גְּרוֹנִי יְעַכֵּב מוֹרַע דִּין. בְּקוֹל עִם שׁוֹפָר: דְּרֹשׁ וְהַעַל רְטִיָּה. לִפְנֵי טְרִיָּה. דַּעַת לִטְרוּיָה. קוֹל חֲבֵשׁ שׁוֹפָר: דָּחוּי לִכְרוּיָה. בְּעַד נָכְרִיָּה.
אַם שַׁבָּת.
מיוסד ע״ס א״ב כפול בראשי החרוזות.

אָנוּסָה לְעֶזְרָה. אֶמְצָא נֶגְדִּי. אֵל קָרוֹב לִי. בְּעֵת קָרְאִי בְּקוֹל: אֲשֶׁר בַּעֲדַת אֵל. בְּקִרְבִּי נִצָּב. וּפֹה בְּמִקְדָּשׁ מְעָט. אֲצַפְצֵף לוֹ בְּקוֹל: בַּקְּרֵנִי דָּרְשֵׁנִי. שֶׂה פְזוּרָה אָנִי. נִגְזַרְתִּי וְנֶאֱלַמְתִּי. בְּלִי לְהָרִים קוֹל: בֶּאֱמוֹר גּוֹזְזַי. נִדָּחָה הִיא. שׁוֹמְרָהּ וְצִלָּהּ. לֹא יִשְׁאַג בְּקוֹל: גַּלְתִּי שִׂיחַ בְּחֻקָּיו. וְחִכִּי עָרֵב. הִטָּה אֹזֶן וְשָׂח. הַשְׁמִיעִנִי אֶת קוֹלֵךְ קוֹל: גָּז וּבָרַח מֶנִּי. כְּעֹפֶר עַל הָרֵי בָתֶר. בְּבַקְּשׁוֹ דָת וָאוֹת. בְּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתַי וְאֵין קוֹל: דִּלֵּג מִבֶּתֶר לְבֶתֶר. הֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֵלַי. אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ. עֵקֶב שָׁמְעֵךְ בְּקוֹל: דְּרוֹשׁ טוֹבָה לָמוֹ. וּרְאֵה שֵׂה מוֹרִיָּה. אֵלֶם פִּיהוּ יְהִי צֶדֶק. לְלֹא שָׁמְעָה בְּקוֹל: הָסֵר מֵחָלָק. יָדַיִם
137 Musaph for the New Year 137

I meditate on righteousness to ascribe righteousness to my Creator; I ask for judgments of righteousness and raise my voice like a Shofar. When none proclaims in righteousness and none pursues righteousness, I call out for a hearing in righteousness in a voice mingled with the Shofar. I understood through my knowledge when I raised my mind far distant and know that the utterance of Teruah sounded at the Revelation through the Shofar. By blowing Teruah I appease my shepherd, who strengthens my arm through the powerful sound of the Shofar. I approached on the day of justice to plead for myself with justice; He reveals the depths of justice through the curdling sound of the Shofar. If I am guilty in justice according to the decree of law and justice, may my throat restrain the severity of justice through my voice together with the Shofar. Seek out and bring healing for the wound, let the mind of the wounded people be soothed by the sound of the Shofar. Let freedom for the banished, who are sold to a strange people, and for every human
On Sabbath.

I hasten for aid and find God near me at the time when I call with my voice. In the congregation of God, He stands in my midst and here in this miniature sanctuary I mutter to Him with my voice. Test me, examine me, a stray sheep am I, I have been cast off and silenced so that I cannot raise my voice. When my shearers say ‘she is rejected’, her guardian and protector does not roar with His voice. When I conversed of His statutes and my sound was pleasing, He inclined His ear and spoke; ‘Let me hear the sound of your voice’. Swiftly He fled from me like the deer on the rocky mountains, when He desired law and a sign from me and in my dwellings there was no voice. He who leapt from fragment to fragment (Abraham), let him restore Him to me, perhaps He will raise your face because you heard His voice. Plead on their behalf, behold the sheep on Moriah, let his silent submission (Isaac) justify those who did not listen to His voice. Keep far from the smooth one (Jacob) the hairy

דְּרוֹר לְכָל בְּרִיָּה. בְּקוֹל הַעֲבָרַת שׁוֹפָר: הָכְשַׁל בְּנַאֲפוּף. בְּזָרַת גִּפּוּף. הֻצַּג בְּרִיב צָפוּף. בְּקוֹל חֶרְדַּת שׁוֹפָר: הָעֳנַשׁ בְּאַפּוּף. וְשָׁב הֱיוֹת חָפוּף. הוֹעִילוֹ לֵב כָּפוּף. בְּקוֹל כְּפִיפַת שׁוֹפָר: וְאִם שׁוֹד יַעַלְזוֹ. וּבַדִּין יְלִיזוֹ. וְצֶדֶק יָרוּץ לְאָחֲזוֹ. בְּקוֹל חִיל שׁוֹפָר: וּכְמוֹ מַכְנִים בְּזוֹ. וּמוֹצִיא בְּזוֹ. וְכֵן מֶנּוּ יְגִיזוֹ. בְּקוֹל רוּחַ שׁוֹפָר: זֶה מִכָּל קוֹלוֹת. אֲשֶׁר בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת. זִקֵּק לִקְהִלּוֹת. קוֹל תֵּקַע שֹׁפָר: זְמַמֵי עֲקַלְקַלֹּת. מְחֻיְּבֵי סְקִילוֹת. זָעוּ בְּגִדּוּעַ מַקְלוֹת. בְּקוֹל שֵׁמַע שׁוֹפָר: חַי מִכָּל שָׁנָה. יוֹם זֶה שִׁנָּה. חָקוּק לְשׁוֹשַׁנָּה. לְקוֹל חֵרוּת שׁוֹפָר: חִבָּתוֹ מִשְׁנֶה. שְׁנִיָּה
אַם שַׁבָּת.

שְׂעִירוֹת. הוֹגֶה בְּתַחֲנוּנִים. כִּי לְךָ הַקּוֹל: הוֹשַׁע. אֲשֶׁר לֹא תִשָּׁכַח עֵדוּת. וּמִפִּי זַרְעוֹ. לֹא יָסוּף קוֹל: וְחוֹזַי וּמְלִיצַי. הֵם בְּנֵי אִמִּי. וְאָז נִחֲרוּ בִי. לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמַע קוֹל: וְעַל מִשְׁמַרְתָּם. יַעַמְדוּ וְיִזְעָקוּ. וְגַל לָהֶם סוֹד. וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם בְּקוֹל: זֶה חָמַק מֶנִּי. אֲסוֹבֵב וַאֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ. בְּכָל מָקוֹם הוּא. אָנָה אֶשָּׂא קוֹל: זֵכֶר דּוֹדִי לְמַטָּה. אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם. מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ. לְמַעְלָה קוֹרְאִים בְּקוֹל: חֲיָלֵי מַיִם. אֲשֶׁר בָּם שְׁבִילוֹ. דִּבְּרוּ תְּמוּנָה לֹא רָאִינוּ. זוּלָתִי קוֹל: חִפַּשְׂתִּי יְשִׁימוֹן הֲיֵשׁ. וְאָמְרוּ אָיִן. קֶדֶם תִּתּוֹ עֹז. בִּעֲתַנִי בְּקוֹל: טָהוֹר דִּלֵּג. הָרִים וְעָבַר. וּמִמְּעוֹן הַר מוֹר. אָז נָתַן קוֹל: טִמֵּאתִי יְדִידוּת שִׁכְנוֹ וְעָלָה. לְיוֹם כֶּסֶא יָבֹא. בְּאָזְנַי קוֹל: יָקַרְתִּי בְּעֵינָיו.
138 Musaph for the New Year 138

creature be granted through the sound of the Shofar. He who has sinned in adultery, through the embrace of the strange woman, and is led, penned up in judgment, dreads the sound of the Shofar. He who was punished in anger and repents to be purified, his bent heart avails him at the sound of the bent Shofar. If the evil impulse had tempted him and he is accused in justice, clemency hastens to hold him up at the tremulous sound of the Shofar. Just as the sound passed through the Shofar, so does the Lord cut short the speech of the accuser at the breath of the sound of the Shofar. Of all the sounds that are heard in assemblies, He has made incumbent on communities the sound of the blast of the Shofar. They who planned crooked deeds, deserving of death by stoning, trembled when the cedars broke at the report of the sound of the Shofar (on the day of the Revelation). The Eternal of every year has set apart this day from the whole year and appointed it for the Rose (Israel) for a proclamation of freedom through the sound of the Shofar. There will be extraordinary love greater than the previous love; the sin of
On Sabbath.

hands (of Esau), when he meditates on entreaties, for to Thee is his voice. Grant help that the testimony should not be forgotten and from the mouth of His seed there should be no end to his voice. My seers and my spokesmen, the sons of my mother, remonstrated with me that I should hear Thy voice. They stand on their watch and cry out; let the secret be revealed to them that the Lord may answer them with His voice. He has left me, I wander about and seek Him, He is in every place, where shall I raise my voice? The fame of my Beloved is below, He is mighty on high, ‘the whole earth is full of His glory’ do they call out above with their voice. The soldiers in the waters through which He made a path (the Sea of Reeds) said ‘we have seen no form but only a voice’. I searched for Him in the desert and they said that He is not there, yet when of old He gave His law, He frightened me with His voice. In purity He leapt over mountains and paths and from His dwelling on Mount Moriah He once sent forth His voice. When I defiled His dear dwelling, He rose up from it, on the hidden day there will come in my ears a voice. I was dear in His eyes and He adhered to me
139 מוּסַף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 139

מֵרִאשׁוֹנָה. חֵטְא כָּל הַשָּׁנָה. דְּחוּת בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר: טֶבַע בְּרָכוֹת תֵּשַׁע. מוּל שׁוֹפָרוֹת תֵּשַׁע. טָהוֹר מֵהֶם יִשַּׁע. בְּקוֹל דַּת שׁוֹפָר: טֶנֶף צְחוּנֵי רֶשַׁע. בְּשׁוּבָם מִפֶּשַׁע. טְרִיָּתָם תְּשַׁעֲשַׁע. בְּקוֹל שֶׁוַע שׁוֹפָר: יִיטַב מִשּׁוֹר פָּר. וּמֵאֵיל הַמְּשֻׁפָּר. יוֹם הַמְּסֻפָּר. לְקוֹל חִדּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר: יֹקֶשׁ יוּפָר. וְסוֹטֵן יֻחְפָּר. יֹשֶׁר לֵב יָשְׁפָּר. בְּקוֹל שִׁפּוּר שׁוֹפָר: כְּעֵת הֵם תֹּקְעִים. גֵּיא מַבְקִיעִים. כְּרַכִּים מַשְׁקִיעִים. בְּקוֹל שְׁאוֹן שׁוֹפָר: כָּל הֲמוֹן מְרֵעִים. בְּחִיל מִתְרוֹעֲעִים. כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵם מַתְרִיעִים. קוֹל יָרִיעַ כַּשּׁוֹפָר: לְקוֹלוֹ כְּיָקְשַׁב. יָבְעַת כָּל מוֹשָׁב. לְאֻמִּים בְּסַעַר יִנְשַׁב.
אַם שַׁבָּת.

וְנִלְוָה לִי בַּשְּׁבִי. עִמּוֹ אָנֹכִי. אָז הִבְטִיחַנִי בְּקוֹל: יָרַד לְשִׁנְעָר. וְשָׂם כֵּס בְּעֵילָם. הִשְׁמִיעַ כַּאֲרִי. וּכְנָחָשׁ קוֹל: כִּלָּה מֶנִּי דּוֹב. כְּהִתְרַפָּה מִמְּלֶאכֶת. חַק בַּמִּכְתָּב. וַיַּעֲבֶר קֹל: כָּבַשׁ לִי. אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי נָמֵר. וְגַם אֲנִי בְּהוֹדָיוֹת סֶלָה. אַשְׁמִיעַ לוֹ קוֹל: לְחַיַּת קָנֶה. אָז מָכַר אֶרֶץ. מִי לִי בַשָּׁמַיִם. אָז הֵרִימָה קוֹל: לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי. מִשִּׁנֵּי בַרְזֶל שִׁוַּעְתִּי. וּמֵרֶגֶל עַבְטִיט. הִצְרַחְתִּי בְּקוֹל: מִדַּת קִצִּי. לֹא הוֹדִיעַנִי. מָתַי בְּאַרְצִי. תּוֹר יַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל: מִיּוֹדְעֵי סֵפֶר. חָתַם קִצִּי. לְבַל דַּעַת צוֹפַי. עֵת יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל: נָא הַבֵּט וּרְאֵה. עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי. אֵין לִי מַכִּיר. לְמִי אֶשָּׂא קוֹל: נֶצַח אֲקַוֶּה. כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל דָּבָר. מִמַּקְשִׁיבֵי. דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל: שׂוֹשׂ יָשִׂישׂ. לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי. בְּשָׁמְעִי דּוֹדִי דּוֹפֵק. עַל פְּתָחַי קוֹל:
139 Musaph for the New Year 139

the whole year is banished by the sound of the Shofar. The form of the nine benedictions corresponds to the nine Shofar blasts; in His purity He allows them to entreat through the prescribed sound of the Shofar. Even those stained with evil, when they repent of transgression, Thou dost soothe their wound at the sound of the cry of the Shofar. Better than the sacrificial bullock and the splendid ram is the day appointed for the sound of renewal of the Shofar. The evil impulse is broken and the accuser disgraced and the upright heart refreshed at the sound of beauty of the Shofar. When once they blew the Shofar (before Jericho), they cleaved asunder the valley; they caused cities to sink through the tumult of the sound of the Shofar. All the multitude of the wicked will shake with trembling when they cry out aloud with a sound as piercing as the Shofar. When His voice is heard, every settlement is terrified, He blows away peoples in a hurricane
On Sabbath.

in captivity, ‘I am with him’ He assured me then with His voice. He went down to Shinear and set up His throne in Elam, where He made heard like a lion and like a serpent a voice. He saved me from the bear — when the work from the Sanctuary was disturbed — which had been inscribed in writing and proclaimed by a voice. He subdued for me the four heads of the leopard and in my gratitude I make heard to Him my voice. He then sold the land to the wild beast of the reeds, ‘who is above me in heaven?’ it boasted aloud with its voice. To the God of my salvation from the teeth of iron I cried and from before the trampling foot I shrieked with my voice. He has not made known to me the measure of my end, when in my land the turtle dove will make heard its voice. Even from scholars has He concealed my end, that my seers may not know the time when they will lift up their voice. Pray look and see my woe and my pain, there is no friend to me to whom I can raise my voice. For ever shall I hope that no word shall be omitted from those who listen for a still small voice. In my midst my heart rejoices when I hear my Beloved sounding on my doors with His voice.
140 מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 140

בְּקוֹל סַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר: לְיוֹדְעָיו יוּשַׁב. לְאוֹת טוֹב יִתְחַשַּׁב. לְעֵת יִתְיַשַּׁב. בְּקוֹל טַעַם שׁוֹפָר: מוֹאֲסָיו לְהַבְקִיעַ. בּוֹגְדָיו לְקַעֲקֵעַ. מוֹרְדָיו לְהַשְׁקִיעַ. בְּקוֹל חִזּוּק שׁוֹפָר: מַאֲרִיךְ בְּהִתָּקֵעַ. מְקַצֵּר בְּהִבָּקֵעַ. מֵרִיעַ וְתוֹקֵעַ. בְּקוֹל שִׁלּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵן אֵימוֹת. מַחְפִּיז אֻמּוֹת. נוּסוּ נוֹאֲמוֹת. מִקּוֹל בּוֹךְ שׁוֹפָר: נוֹתֵץ חוֹמוֹת. מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת. נוֹהֵם כַּהֲמוֹת. קוֹל שַׁאַג שׁוֹפָר: סוֹדוֹ כְּגִלָּה. בְּסִין לְסֶגֻלָּה. סִים מְגִלָּה. בְּקוֹל הִלּוּךְ שׁוֹפָר: סוֹד יוֹם גְּאֻלָּה. בְּחָסְפּוֹ לִדְגוּלָה. שָׂשׂוֹן וְגִילָה. קוֹל יַשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹפָר: עָשׂוֹר דּוֹחֶה. עֹנֶג מַדְחֶה. עֲבֵרוֹת מְמַחֶה.
אַם שַׁבָּת.
סֶלָה יְשִׂימֵנִי. כַּחוֹתָם עַל לֵב. כְּאָז תַּֽחַת הַתַּפּוּחַ. עוֹרְרַֽנִי בְּקוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל־הָהָר וְקֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה:
עִלִּיתַֽנִי אֵל. עַל כָּל בָּנוֹת. כִּי בַעֲבוּרִי. בְּחוֹרֵב תַּתָּה קוֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים מְאֹד נִתְעַלֵּיתָ. נֶצַח תִּתְעַלֶּה. בִּתְרוּעַת קוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְיָ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר: וְנֶאֱמַר בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְיָ:
פָּעָה מִמִּדְבָּר. צִפּוֹר מִמִּצְרַיִם. וְיוֹנָה הִשְׁמִיעָה. מֵאַשּׁוּר קוֹל: פְּקוֹד צִפּוֹר בַּיִת. דְּרוֹשׁ יוֹנַת אֵלֶם. תְּקַע לָמוֹ בַּשּׁוֹפָר. וּשְׁרֹק לָמוֹ בְּקוֹל:
140 Musaph for the New Year 140

through the stormy sound of the Shofar. For those who know Him, there is comfort, it is reckoned a good sign for the establishment of peace through the pleasant sound of the Shofar. They who reject Him will be cut down, the faithless will be uprooted, rebels will sink down through the powerful sound of the Shofar. It sounds long drawn-out blasts and then short sharp notes, Teruah and Tekiah are included in the threefold sound of the Shofar. It spreads fear, shakes nations so that they speak of flight from the menacing sound of the Shofar. It tears down walls and makes an end of wars, like the roaring of the waves is the roaring sound of the Shofar. When the Lord revealed His will to His own people on Mount Sinai, the Revelation concluded with the long drawn out sound of the Shofar. When once the secret of redemption will be revealed to those exalted, jubilation and rejoicing He will proclaim through the sound of the Shofar. On the tenth of Tishri was it sounded, even on the day of the Sabbath rest, sins were obliterated through the ringing sound of the
On Sabbath.
Truly He will bear me as a seal on the heart as once when beneath the apple tree He roused me with His voice.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’.
Thou hast raised me, O God, over all daughters since on my behalf on Horeb didst Thou give voice. Over all gods art Thou greatly exalted, to eternity shalt Thou be exalted with the Teruah’s voice.
As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the Lord with a Shofar sound’. And it is said: ‘With trumpets and a Shofar sound cry out before the King, the Lord’.

A bird from Egypt (Israel) cooed from the wilderness and a dove from Assyria sounded its voice. Take note of the bird of Thy household, seek out the patient dove, blow the Shofar for them and whistle to them with Thy voice.
141 מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 141

בְּקוֹל צֶרַח שׁוֹפָר: עֲוֹנוֹת מוֹחֶה. עַבְדוּת מְאַחֶה. עֲבוֹדוֹת מַנְחֶה. קוֹל חִצּוּר שׁוֹפָר: פַּגֵּר וְהַסְעִיר. מַמְלְכוּת שָׂעִיר. פִּשְׁעָהּ תָּעִיר. בְּקוֹל קוֹלוֹת שׁוֹפָר: פִּתְחֵי הָעִיר. תַּשְׁקִיעַ וְתַבְעִיר. פַּחַד רַב וְצָעִיר. מִקּוֹל הֶמְיַת שׁוֹפָר: צִיּוּן רֶמֶז אוֹת. שׁוֹפָרוֹת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת. צְוָחָה בְּמִדְיָן דְּאוֹת. בְּקוֹל שִׁתּוּף שׁוֹפָר: צִפְצְפוּ צְבָאוֹת. כְּשָׁרוּ פְּלָאוֹת. צוּר כְּעַשׂ נִפְלָאוֹת. בְּקוֹל עָרֵב שׁוֹפָר: קוֹל חֲלוּשָׁה. בְּאַרְקָא חֲלָשָׁה. קֹלוֹת מַתַּן שְׁלֹשָׁה. קוֹלוֹת כְּנִתְּנוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר: קֶרֶן מְשֻׁלָּשָׁה. הַיּוֹם לְזֵכֶר אֲשַׁלְּשָׁה. קְרוֹא עוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה. בְּקוֹל עִתּוּד שׁוֹפָר: רָחַשְׁתִּי לַעֲלִית.
אַם שַׁבָּת.

כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל וּבָאוּ הָאֹבְדִים בְּאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר וְהַנִּדָּחִים בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַייָ בְּהַר הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם:
צֹר חֻקִּים מֶנִּי. לְבַל יָעוּפוּ כַנֶּשֶׁר. לְבַל יִכָּנְפוּ. מַשְׁמִיעֵי קוֹל: צְרוּפָה אֶלְמַד. וְעֵינַי לְמוֹרִי. כְּאָז צִיר מְדַבֵּר. וְאֵל מְשִׁיבוֹ בְּקוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל:
קָרֵב קֵץ. בָּא עֵת מִשְׁפָּט. קָם מֵלִיץ יֹשֶׁר. לְהִתְחַנֵּן בְּקוֹל: קֻדַּשׁ חֹדֶשׁ. וְהוּכַן מוֹעֵד. וָאֶתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר. וְיַעֲנֶה לִי בְּקוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֶּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב:
141 Musaph for the New Year 141

Shofar. Sins are annulled and slavery is lifted and works are restored through the embracing sound of the Shofar. Destroy and cast away the realm of Seir, remember its transgression at the reverberating sound of the Shofar. Let the gates of the city sink and disappear, let fright overcome great and small at the roaring sound of the Shofar. Threefold miraculous signs, three hundred horns set up a loud lament in Midian at the accompanying sound of the Shofar. Israel’s hosts rejoiced at witnessing the miracles when the Creator showed His might through the sweet sound of the Shofar. A slender voice descended upon earth, there were threefold sounds of thunder at the Revelation when sounds were given on the Shofar. A threefold sound of the horn will I blow this day as a symbol of the threefold call of the Shofar (at the redemption) that will one day resound from the future Shofar. I pray to heaven and my eyes are lifted up that I may be allowed to see the gathering of the exiles at the loud sound of the Shofar.
On Sabbath.

As it is written through Thy prophet: ‘And on that day the great Shofar will be blown and the wanderers in the land of Assyria and the banished in the land of Egypt shall come and prostrate themselves to the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem’.

Fasten Thy laws to me lest they fly away like the eagle, lest there take flight those who make heard Thy voice. I will learn the pure law with my eyes on my Teacher just as once His messenger (Moses) spoke and God answered him with His voice.
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’.

The end has approached, the time of judgment comes, a defender arises to entreat with his voice. The new moon is sanctified and the feast prepared, so let me blow the Shofar that He may answer me with His voice.
As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘Blow the Shofar on the new moon, when the moon is covered on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob’.
142 מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 142

וְעֵינַי תְּלוּיוֹת. רְאוֹת כְּנוּס גָּלֻיּוֹת. בְּקוֹל גֹּדֶל שׁוֹפָר: רְבִיעִית חַיּוֹת. לִיקוֹד לִהְיוֹת. רֶשֶׁף שַׁלְהֲבִיוֹת. בְּקוֹל לַהַב שׁוֹפָר: שֵׁנָה תְּעוֹרֵר. לְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְצוֹרֵר. שְׁאוֹנוֹ תְפוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל גְּבוּרוֹת שׁוֹפָר: שׁוֹשָׁן תַּדְרֵר. גְּאֻלָּה תְבָרֵר. שׁוֹכְנִים תְּזוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל הַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר: תְּיַשֵּׁר מֵחֶרְמוֹן. לְרוֹעַ אַדְמוֹן. תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן. בְּקוֹל הֲמוֹן שׁוֹפָר: תִּצְעַד כְּבִישִׁימוֹן. בְּמַתַּן אָמוֹן. תַּשְׁמִיעַ בְּאַרְמוֹן. קוֹל קוֹרֵא כַּשּׁוֹפָר:

כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיֹת הַבֹּקֶר וַיְהִי קֹלֹת וּבְרָקִים וְעָנָן כָּבֵד עַל־הָהָר וְקוֹל שֹׁפָר חָזָק מְאֹד וַיֶּחֱרַד כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה: וְנֶאֱמַר וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאֹד מֹשֶׁה יְדַבֵּר וְהָאֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶנּוּ בְקוֹל: וְנֶאֱמַר וְכָל־הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל
אַם שַׁבָּת.
רֶגֶשׁ מִקֶּבֶר. צְוָחָה מִסֶּלַע. בְּתֵת יְבֵשֵׁי עֶצֶם. מֵעָפָר קוֹל: רְאוּ נֵס בֶּהָרִים. וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר בָּאָרֶץ. לְהַשְׁמִיעַ רֶנֶן. מְדוּמֵּי קוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְשֹׁכְנֵי אָרֶץ כִּנְשֹׂא־נֵס הָרִים תִּרְאוּ וְכִתְקֹעַ שׁוֹפָר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ:
שֶׁגֶג לֵב הוּתַל. עוֹד בַּל יַטֶּנוּ. בְּלִי לְהַכְבִּיד אֹזֶן. מִשְּׁמוֹעַ קוֹל: שׁוֹבֵב לִי כְּקֶדֶם. דַּת מוֹרָשָׁה. אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ עִלַּפְתַּנִי. בְּלַפִּידִים וָקוֹל:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וְכָל־הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִם וְאֵת קוֹל הַשֹּׁפָר וְאֶת־הָהָר עָשֵׁן וַיַּרְא הָעָם וַיָּנֻֽעוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מֵרָחֹק:
תְּבוּנָה הֵפִיק. אִישׁ נְבוֹן דָּבָר. וְחַק נֹעַם זְמִירוֹת.
142 Musaph for the New Year 142

The fourth of the wild beasts (that Daniel saw) will fall into the fire, among the sparking flames at the fiery sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt stir up sleep to pay retribution to the oppressor, and shatter his multitudes with the mighty sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt free the Rose (Israel) and let redemption dawn, revive those who slumber with the rousing sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt march from Hermon to destroy Admon, bring cooling to Tsalmon with the massive sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt step in our midst as once in the wilderness when Thou didst give us the Torah and once again wilt Thou allow to be heard in the Sanctuary a voice that sounds like that of the Shofar.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’. And it was said: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’. And it was said: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance’. And in Thy holy words it is written saying: ‘God has arisen with Teruah, the
On Sabbath.

There will be stirring from the grave, a shout from the rock when the dry bones from the dust give voice. Witness the banner on the mountains and the sound of the Shofar on earth when there is heard the exultation of those long silent of voice.
As it is written through Thy prophet: ‘All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, when the banner is raised on the mountains shall you see and when the Shofar is blown shall you hear’.

No longer shall the heart mocked by error refuse to incline, no longer shall the ear be deaf and not hear the voice. Restore to me as of old the law of my inheritance, as when Thou didst shatter me with lightning and the voice.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance.

מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׂר יוֹצְרֵנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּנוּ כֵּן תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵנוּ וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצֹנֶךָ וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם עַל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ. בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת:

וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל־בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּֽלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:
אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בָּרְכֵנוּ בַּבְּרָכָה הַמְשֻׁלֶּשֶׁת בַּתּוֹרָה הַכְּתוּבָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ הָאֲמוּרָה מִפִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו כֹּהֲנִים עַם קְדוֹשֶׁךָ כָּאָמוּר:
145 Musaph for the New Year 145
While the Kohanim make their way to the דוכן, the congregation say: ותערב

May our entreaty be pleasing to Thee like the whole-offering and the sacrifice. O Merciful One, restore Thy presence to Zion in Thy great mercies and the order of worship to Jerusalem. Let our eyes behold Thy return to Zion in compassion and let us serve Thee there in awe as in olden times and former years. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, whom alone we wish to worship in awe.

We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy sindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
Congregation:

We thank Thee because Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of all flesh, our Creator, the Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanks to Thy Great and Holy Name for having kept us alive and let us survive. So mayest Thou further keep us alive and let us survive and gather our exiles to the court-yards of Thy Sanctuary in order to observe Thy statutes and do Thy will and serve Thee whole-heartedly; wherefore we thank Thee. Blessed be God to whom thanks are due.

For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever. And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant. And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing that is written in the Torah through Moses Thy servant and was uttered by the mouth of Aaron and his sons the priests, Thy holy people, as it is said:
